brand.name: CoreLink
brand.tagline: Shared content-addressable cache for builds, packages, and ML.

hero.heading: A shared content-addressable cache, finally built for multi-tenant teams.
hero.subheading: CoreLink deduplicates and audits the blobs your CI, your registries, and your model store re-upload a hundred times a day — across regions, across workloads, across teams — with cryptographic tenant isolation and an append-only Merkle audit chain.
hero.ctaSub: No card required to start · Free tier with R2 zero-egress

demo.title: See it in 90 seconds
demo.placeholderHint: A 90-second walkthrough: point your build cache at CoreLink, watch a cold build go warm, and read the signed audit trail.

isolation.title: Tenant isolation, modelled in TLA+.
isolation.body: The difference between marketing-language multi-tenant and actually-multi-tenant is a formal proof. CoreLink keeps a TLA+ specification of cross-tenant byte non-leakage and runs it in CI on every change. If the safety property regresses, the build fails. We don't trust ourselves to get this right by code review alone.
isolation.b3: Tenant boundary verified in CI on every commit

audit.title: Audit you can actually prove.
audit.body: Every CAS read and write appends to a per-tenant append-only Merkle log. Each entry is Ed25519-signed. The full log is replayable. You can answer the auditor's question — what happened on this artefact, when, and has anything been retro-edited? — with a cryptographic proof, not a vendor's word.

multiRegion.title: Four regions. Residency you control.
multiRegion.body: Active in US-East, EU-West, AP-Southeast, and AU-East on Cloudflare R2 + Workers + D1. Reads route locally; writes converge globally; residency policies are enforced per tenant — not assumed and not opt-in. EU bytes stay in EU. AU bytes stay in AU.

closing.heading: Stop re-uploading the same bytes. Start with CoreLink.
